announcements.headline: Bango and Ooredoo Group partnership
announcements.insight: This partnership expands Bango's reach into the high-growth Middle East telecoms market, leveraging Ooredoo's extensive subscriber base to drive mobile billing revenue; it signals strategic growth in emerging markets but lacks immediate financial quantification.
